verdict.rationale: Zero lets users delete and bulk-delete emails and delete labels, including through its MCP server, so an AI agent can carry out deletion. Self-hosting lets users keep the app and its data under their own control, and the README says Zero does not track, collect, or sell user data. None of this is a dedicated retention or deletion control; it is mailbox-level deletion plus infrastructure ownership. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, account/data purge controls, deletion of AI-processed or derived data (summaries, indexes), documented data-handling and retention policy, and independent corroboration.
